title: 面向大规模动态图的图神经网络优化机制研究

novelty_points.claim: 提出了一种基于图摘要的大规模时序图表示学习方法GSAERU，该方法将动态时序图建模为各时刻的图快照序列，利用图摘要技术压缩原图后输入图自编码器学习节点表征，再通过循环神经网络捕获时间维度上的特征依赖，从而高效生成大规模时序图的低维表征。
novelty_points.claim_en: Proposed a large-scale sequential graph representation learning method GSAERU based on graph summarization, which models dynamic sequential graphs as a sequence of graph snapshots, uses graph summarization to compress the original graph and feeds it into a graph autoencoder to learn node representations, then employs a recurrent neural network to capture temporal dependencies, thereby efficiently generating low-dimensional representations of large-scale sequential graphs.
technical_features: 通过图摘要技术对原始大规模图进行压缩，降低后续处理复杂度
利用图自编码器重构原图来训练节点表征，保证表征质量
引入循环神经网络学习不同时间步上表征的时间依赖关系
technical_features_en: Compresses the original large-scale graph using graph summarization to reduce downstream processing complexity
Trains node representations using a graph autoencoder with reconstruction loss against the original graph
Employs a recurrent neural network to learn temporal dependencies of representations across time steps

novelty_points.claim: 提出了基于图摘要的分布式图神经网络优化训练算法DSGNN，采用“领导-工作者”模式，由领导节点基于边分割的图流划分算法划分原图，工作节点执行基于图摘要技术的小批量训练，并通过注意力层返回结果，领导节点汇总计算梯度并同步更新所有节点模型，显著加速GNN训练并提升链路预测性能。
novelty_points.claim_en: Proposed a distributed graph neural network optimization training algorithm DSGNN based on graph summarization, which adopts a leader-worker mode, where the leader divides the original graph using a graph flow partition algorithm based on edge segmentation, workers perform mini-batch training based on graph summarization, and an attention layer is used to return results, then the leader aggregates results, computes gradients, and synchronously updates all model replicas, greatly accelerating GNN training and improving link prediction performance.
technical_features: 采用“领导-工作者”分布式工作模式，由领导节点负责图划分和梯度汇总
提出基于边分割的图流划分算法，将原图划分为子图分配给工作节点
工作节点使用图摘要技术进行小批量训练，降低通信与计算开销
通过注意力层聚合各工作节点的训练结果，再由领导节点计算梯度并同步更新所有节点模型
technical_features_en: Adopts a leader-worker distributed mode, where the leader node is responsible for graph partitioning and gradient aggregation
Proposes a graph flow partition algorithm based on edge segmentation to divide the original graph into subgraphs assigned to workers
Workers use graph summarization for mini-batch training to reduce communication and computation cost
An attention layer aggregates the training results from workers, and the leader computes gradients and synchronously updates all model replicas

novelty_points.claim: 提出了一种面向大规模动态图的图神经网络优化机制，该机制通过图摘要技术对图数据进行压缩，并分别结合时序学习模块和分布式训练框架，实现了在大规模时序图上的高效表示学习和分布式场景下的快速模型训练，有效解决了现有GNN在处理大规模动态图时训练效率低下的问题。
novelty_points.claim_en: Proposed an optimization mechanism for graph neural networks on large-scale dynamic graphs, which compresses graph data via graph summarization and combines with sequence learning and distributed training frameworks to achieve efficient representation learning on large-scale sequential graphs and fast model training in distributed scenarios, effectively addressing the low training efficiency of existing GNNs on large-scale dynamic graphs.
technical_features: 通过图摘要技术压缩大规模图数据，降低计算复杂度
结合时序学习模块捕获时间维度特征，适用于动态图
结合分布式训练框架，通过任务划分和并行计算加速模型训练
technical_features_en: Compresses large-scale graph data via graph summarization to reduce computational complexity
Incorporates a temporal learning module to capture time-dimension features for dynamic graphs
Incorporates a distributed training framework to accelerate model training via task partitioning and parallel computing
